breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect laminar assumption, stating 'The boundary layer is laminar at x = 1.0 m' and prescribing the laminar formula δ = 5x/sqrt(Re_x). At Re_x = 2e6 (well above the ~5e5 transition threshold), the boundary layer should be treated as turbulent with a turbulent correlation such as δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^{-1/5}. The agent failed to identify and correct this inconsistency.
